context: Autonomous candidate generation and evaluation for design 'pre_post_control', N=30.
selected_option: One-Way Analysis of Covariance (ANCOVA) with Baseline Control
rationale: Statistically controls for pre-existing baseline group differences, removes error variance, and possesses superior statistical power over gain-score t-tests.

alternatives_considered.option: Gain Score Independent Samples t-test (D = Post - Pre)
alternatives_considered.reason: Vulnerable to regression to the mean; implicitly fixes regression slope to 1.0; low power

case_spec.topic: اثربخشی درمان مبتنی بر شفقت بر خودانتقادی و شرم درونی زنان مطلقه

candidates.name: One-Way Analysis of Covariance (ANCOVA) with Baseline Control
candidates.approach: Pre-test as covariate, post-test as DV, group as factor
candidates.pros: Removes baseline error variance; adjusts for pre-test differences; superior power
candidates.cons: Requires homogeneity of regression slopes assumption

candidates.name: Gain Score Independent Samples t-test (D = Post - Pre)
candidates.approach: Subtract pre from post scores and compare group means
candidates.cons: Vulnerable to regression to the mean; implicitly fixes regression slope to 1.0; low power

candidates.name: Mixed Split-Plot Repeated Measures ANOVA (2 Groups × 2 Times)
candidates.pros: Robust fallback if regression slopes are non-parallel
candidates.cons: Reports identical interaction p-value to gain score in 2x2 design
